standard_prerequisites.use: First order thickenings, formally unramified morphisms, the affine case from the Algebra chapter, and the gluing of schemes along open subschemes. The affine input and the gluing theorem are cited as prerequisites; the non-affine descent, the cocycle verification and the gluing of the local maps are all retained in the author's proof.

core_obligations: Establish the two general remarks: uniqueness of a universal first order thickening up to unique isomorphism, and inheritance of the universal property by an open V in Z over an open U in X.

Perform the gluing: build local universal thickenings Z_i' from an affine open cover, prove the transition isomorphisms satisfy the cocycle condition, glue to a thickening Z in Z' over X, and verify the universal property locally.

proof_roadmap.step: Record uniqueness up to unique isomorphism and the inheritance of the universal property by open subschemes V in Z over U in X, using that a thickening has the same underlying topological space.
Solve the affine case X = Spec(R), Z = Spec(S) using the Algebra chapter's universal thickening, then reduce a general diagram to affine charts and glue the local maps.

spans.label: affine case and reduction to affine charts

proof_roadmap.step: Choose an affine open cover of Z mapping into affine opens of X, obtain local universal thickenings, prove the transition isomorphisms are canonical and satisfy the cocycle condition, and glue using the gluing results for schemes.

spans.label: gluing of the local universal thickenings

proof_roadmap.step: Conclude that the glued Z' is universal for an arbitrary thickening by covering T' and gluing the resulting maps a'_i.

spans.label: verification of the universal property for a general thickening

difficulty_reason: This is the construction that later results take for granted: the universal first order thickening Z in Z' of a formally unramified morphism is built from scratch by gluing affine pieces. The proof first records two general remarks (uniqueness up to unique isomorphism, and that an open V in Z sitting over an open U in X inherits the universal property), then solves the affine case by reducing an arbitrary diagram to affine charts and gluing the resulting maps, and finally performs the global descent: it takes an affine open cover of Z mapping into affine opens of X, obtains local universal thickenings Z_i', shows the overlaps Z'_{i,j} and Z'_{j,i} are both universal thickenings of Z_i n Z_j so that a canonical isomorphism and the cocycle condition follow, glues via the gluing results for schemes, and checks the universal property for a general thickening by a second local-to-global argument. The load-bearing content is the cocycle verification and the final gluing of the a'_i; the author marks the cocycle check as a verification omitted with a hint, which is retained verbatim.
